_policy: Exact YouTube channel IDs only. A channel is ingested only when source_verified AND enabled are both true. Verification is a first-party link: the league's own site (wnba.com) or the team's own official site on the wnba.com domain links the channel URL, and that URL resolves to the recorded externalId. A display name, a handle or a verified badge is never sufficient on its own. scripts/videos/verify-channels.mjs re-proves every row live and fails on any drift.
_never_ingest: Fan/highlight compilation accounts, reuploads, mirrors of TikTok/X/Instagram clips, and any channel whose exact ID we have not proved from a first-party link. Video is never downloaded or rehosted: we store provider ids and metadata and construct the privacy-enhanced embed at render time.

pending.name: ESPN
pending.reason: ESPN is a WNBA broadcast partner, but no first-party ESPN property we can fetch (espn.com/wnba, espnpressroom.com) publishes a link to a YouTube channel, so the exact channel identity is not proved by our own standard. The ID above is what youtube.com/@ESPN canonicalises to and is recorded only so the row is not re-litigated; it stays disabled. It is also a general-sports firehose, so enabling it would need a WNBA-scoped relevance gate as well as an identity proof.
